sources.dependency_boundary: The displayed proofs use earlier normal-form, trace-extension and model estimates, including Lemmas 4.1, 5.1, 5.2 and 5.5, plus standard interior elliptic regularity. Their entire proof chain, the later general boundary/index theory and the published 2012 edition were not declared fully audited here. The new application supplies its finite-ground-jump, domain, adjoint and coercive surjectivity argument; standard local elliptic regularity and H1 trace/extension remain accepted analytic inputs.
sources.use: Established transmission and trace framework. The positive-resolution realization follows from cancellation of internal flux and complementary dissipative ground ports, not a uniform contraction of the infinite load.
sources.access: Downloaded from the primary institutional archive with normal TLS verification. The cached PDF is the preprint actually inspected, not substituted publisher bytes.

independent_results: Keeping all higher throat modes in the Hilbert space leaves only a finite-dimensional smooth jump at the seams. A collar lift and interior elliptic regularity prove L2 traces and identify the two adjoint domains.
The two coercive estimates prove the prescribed loaded resolvent and its uniform positive-resolution bounds. Ground closure gives a self-adjoint free Dirac operator on the prescribed background.
Smoothing the remote connection costs at most C q p^(3/2) on the existing trial. Choosing p=q^-1 preserves the previous q^-3/8 residual order and improves all weighted port terms.

Exact isolated-monopole data on an inner open flat collar and exact dipole data on an outer open collar cannot be joined by a static source-free Maxwell field. Harmonic continuation, or the explicit nonzero uniform-field multipole equation rho chi''+4chi'=0, proves the obstruction. It does not exclude a nonspherical or curved physical throat.
verification_boundary: Finite coupled-channel BVPs, independent scattering feedback, forced current checks, exact curl algebra and all-angular-profile shell upper bounds are supplementary. No infinite-dimensional existence claim is inferred from truncation convergence, and no 3D dipole or vacuum stress simulation was performed.
decision: Retain physical long-return damping and matched finite-duration band transfer. The prescribed loaded realization is available. The physical next step must allow remote multipoles or a controlled metric/matter response; a flat exactly spherical cutoff is not a source-free completion. Novelty and the physical endpoint remain unaccepted.
remaining: Physical Einstein-Maxwell interface and state, full angular/exterior-determinant and discarded-tail response, renormalized stress, complete literature and novelty review, consequential result, independent verification, GCP-only certification and manuscript.
